data.one_liner: Free and unlimited Google Translate API wrapper for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Translates strings and text between different languages using a free Google Translate API approach. It supports auto-detecting source languages, returning detailed Translation objects, and provides a convenient string extension method.
use_when: You need a quick translation tool for educational purposes.
You want to translate text strings in Dart or Flutter without setting up paid API keys.
avoid_when: You are building a production app, as the underlying web crawling may break at any time.
You need an official, guaranteed stable Google Translate API.
strengths: Provides a convenient string extension method for direct translations
weaknesses: Based on crawling the Google Translate website and may break anytime
Disclaimer explicitly states it should not be used for production
Not documented for complex localization architectures

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides official localization, message formatting, and date/number localization for production-ready apps.
